intents.name: course_overview
intents.description: General introduction, description, and summary of a course
examples: Give me an overview of Operating Systems

intents.name: course_outcome
intents.description: Course outcomes (COs) and learning outcomes expected upon course completion
examples: What are the course outcomes of DBMS?
What will I learn in Operating Systems?

intents.name: course_objectives
intents.description: Educational objectives and instructional goals of the course
examples: What are the objectives of Data Structures?
Explain instructional goals of Machine Learning

intents.name: syllabus
intents.description: Complete syllabus outline or module breakdown of a course
examples: What is the syllabus for Operating Systems?
Give me the syllabus for DBMS

intents.name: course_code
intents.description: Official catalog course code identifier (e.g., CS301)
examples: What is the course code for Operating Systems?

intents.name: credits
intents.description: Academic credit allocation and lecture/tutorial/practical distribution
examples: How many credits does Computer Networks have?
What are the credits for Operating Systems?

intents.name: prerequisites
intents.description: Prior coursework or knowledge needed before enrolling
examples: What are the prerequisites for Machine Learning?
What do I need to know before Compiler Design?

intents.name: units
intents.description: Total number of units/modules and unit breakdown of a course
examples: How many units are there in DBMS?

intents.name: unit_topics
intents.description: Specific topics and sub-sections taught in a designated unit
examples: What topics are covered in Unit 3 of DBMS?
Topics in Unit 1 of Computer Networks?
What is taught in OS Unit 4?

intents.name: semester_subjects
intents.description: List of all curriculum courses offered in a specific semester
examples: Which subjects are available in semester 5?

intents.name: branch_subjects
intents.description: Subjects offered under a specific academic branch or engineering department
examples: List courses for Computer Science Engineering

intents.name: faculty_information
intents.description: Teaching faculty, course coordinators, and office hours
examples: Who is the faculty for Operating Systems?

intents.name: academic_regulations
intents.description: Academic rules, attendance criteria, passing marks, and grading guidelines
examples: Minimum passing percentage for theory courses?

intents.name: examination_information
intents.description: Midterm exams, final exams, continuous internal assessment, and evaluation schemes
examples: What is the exam pattern for DBMS?

intents.name: lab_information
intents.description: Practical laboratory sessions, experiment lists, and lab manuals
examples: Is there a lab for DBMS?
What experiments are in the OS lab?

intents.name: elective_information
intents.description: Professional electives, open electives, and elective baskets
examples: What electives are offered in semester 7?
Can I take AI as an elective?

intents.name: course_structure
intents.description: Overall curriculum scheme, degree requirements, and credit distribution across semesters
examples: What is the overall course structure of B.Tech CSE?

intents.name: subject_comparison
intents.description: Comparative analysis between two courses, syllabi, or difficulty
examples: Difference between DBMS and Operating Systems?
Compare Machine Learning with Artificial Intelligence

intents.name: curriculum_search
intents.description: Broad or exploratory search across curriculum topics

intents.name: greeting
intents.description: Conversational opening and polite greetings

intents.name: thanks
intents.description: Polite appreciation and closing expressions

intents.name: help
intents.description: Guidance on how to use the chatbot and available queries
examples: How do I use this chatbot?

intents.name: fallback
intents.description: Out-of-scope, ambiguous, or unrecognizable queries
examples: Who won the football world cup?
What is the capital of France?
